services.name: Building Histories: A Walking Tour
services.desc: Join Island historian, retired cemetery commissioner, and Vineyard History Tours owner Liz Villard for a walking tour through Tower Hill Cemetery in Edgartown.Also known as Old Town Cemetery or Green Hollow, Tower Hill contains pre-Revolutionary, Revolutionary War, and Puritan-era graves dating to the 17th century. Through the headstones and stories of some of the Island’s most memorable residents, Villard will offer a vivid window into Martha’s Vineyard’s early history.Tower Hill Cemetery is located off Tower Hill Road, near Katama Road and Katama Bay in Edgartown. For GPS navigation, use 191 Katama Road, Edgartown, MA 02539.Admission: $20 per
